plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I argued all night in a room with no doors, and neither of us would give an inch.
In the dream I finally said everything I've been holding back, and {OTHER_nameDef} just went on mending a boot.
Last night {OTHER_nameDef} had taken my bed, my tools and my name, and they were all calling {OTHER_objective} by it.
{OTHER_nameDef} stood at the end of my bed in the dream, and I was too angry to speak.
[trait:Volatile|trait:Abrasive] I threw a cup at {OTHER_nameDef}. It never landed. It just kept going, out the window and over the hills.
[again] The same argument with {OTHER_nameDef} again. I lose it a different way every night.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I shouted ourselves hoarse in my dream, then sat down and shared a pipe. I don't know what to make of that.

blunt.li: Fought with {OTHER_nameDef} all night in my sleep. Still angry.
Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. Woke up angrier.

cheerful.li: Won an argument with {OTHER_nameDef} in my dream! It doesn't count, but still.

gloomy.li: Even asleep I can't get away from {OTHER_nameDef}.

cold.li: My grievance with {OTHER_nameDef} followed me into sleep. I'd like it to stay out.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a debt repaid

plain.li: In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} was in trouble, and for once I was the one who could help.
Built {OTHER_nameDef} a house with my own hands last night, with a window on every side.
{OTHER_nameDef} walked beside me all night, carrying half of everything I carried.
I found the words to thank {OTHER_nameDef} properly in my dream. They were simple ones. I should be able to manage them awake.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} was a giant, and I rode in {OTHER_possessive} pocket over the fields.

warm.li: In my dream we gave {OTHER_nameDef} a feast, and I got to carry in the bread.

blunt.li: Dreamt I paid {OTHER_nameDef} back. Should do that awake.

cheerful.li: Gave {OTHER_nameDef} a present in my dream so good {OTHER_pronoun} cried!

gloomy.li: Dreamt I owed {OTHER_nameDef} more than I'll ever be able to give back.

cold.li: I owe {OTHER_nameDef}. The dream was a reminder. I'll settle it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of someone else's life

plain.li: In the dream I woke up as {OTHER_nameDef}, in {OTHER_possessive} bed, and it fit me better than mine.
At supper in the dream they were all praising {OTHER_nameDef}, and the bread went right past me.
{OTHER_nameDef} had the best room in my dream, and the warm coat, and I stood outside at the window.
Had a dream they gave me {OTHER_nameDef}'s work, and I did it better, and the whole time they were watching {OTHER_objective}.
[trait:Greedy|trait:Jealous] I took {OTHER_nameDef}'s things one at a time, and each one turned to sand in my hands.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I swapped lives for a day, and by evening we both wanted our own back.

blunt.li: Had what {OTHER_nameDef} has, in the dream. Didn't feel as good as I thought.

cheerful.li: I had a dream I was the colony's favorite! For once it was {OTHER_nameDef} looking on.

gloomy.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef}'s luck was a pile of firewood and mine was one damp stick.

cold.li: A dream of envy, about {OTHER_nameDef}. Noted, and set aside.

plain.li: Footsteps one corner behind me, all night, stopping when I stopped.
Hid under the floor all night while footsteps went back and forth over my head.
Running, and my legs wouldn't work. The ground kept pulling at them.
The walls had holes in them I'd never noticed, and something was looking through each one.
[child] There was a monster under my bed and it knew my name.
[afterraid] The raiders were back, and every door I shut behind me opened again on its own.
[tribal] The wolves had our scent, and the drums wouldn't stop.

warm.li: I was hiding in my dream, and someone took my hand and led me somewhere safe. I never saw who.

blunt.li: Chased all night in my sleep. Didn't get caught.

cheerful.li: Nightmare about being chased! I outran it, though.

gloomy.li: It caught me, in the dream. It always does.

cold.li: A fear dream. Predictable, given the week.

plain.li: A cloud on the horizon that got bigger every time I looked up from my work.
Dreamt the whole colony was waiting at the gate for something, holding its breath, and it never came, and we couldn't stop waiting.
Drums, far off and getting closer, and the others went on eating as if they couldn't hear.
I was marking the days on a wall, and there was no more wall.
[winter] Had a dream the snow kept rising up the walls until it covered the windows, and we sat in the dark listening to it.

warm.li: Something was coming in my dream, and we all stood at the wall together. That part I liked.

blunt.li: Bad dream. Something coming. Checked the walls.

cheerful.li: Dreamt something awful was coming over the hill, and it was a very large goat.

gloomy.li: Something's coming. The dream just said it out loud.

cold.li: Something coming, in the dream, nothing I could name. I'll check the stores anyway.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of being found out

plain.li: They all knew what I'd done, in the dream. Not a word, just looking.
My mistake was carved over the dining room door, and I had to walk under it to eat.
Stood before the council while they read out every wrong thing I've ever done. It took all night.
Scrubbing my hands all night, and the water kept running dirty.
[child] I broke something in my dream and everyone saw.

warm.li: Dreamt I told everyone what I did, and they were kinder about it than I am.

blunt.li: What I did, all night, over and over. Didn't help.

cheerful.li: My worst secret came out in my dream, and they all just laughed and passed the salt!

gloomy.li: The dream told everyone what I already know about myself.

cold.li: A shame dream. Unpleasant, and it taught me nothing.

plain.li: The colony was full of people, and none of them could see me. I stood by the table and waved.
I talked and talked, and the words came out as birdsong.
They all went into a room laughing and shut the door. I could hear them through the wall.
Someone sat down next to me and just stayed. I can't remember the face, only that they stayed.
[newcomer] Dreamt everyone here had known each other for years and spoke a language I hadn't learned yet.
[old] In the dream all my old friends were sitting on a porch, alive, and there was a chair for me.

warm.li: Someone in my dream knocked on my door just to see how I was. I'd like that to happen awake.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was alone. I mostly am.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the whole colony threw me a surprise party! I'm taking it as a sign.

gloomy.li: Even in my dreams I eat alone.

cold.li: Dreamt nobody could see me. It was restful.

plain.li: Everything was gray, the food and the sky and the faces, and I was the only one who minded.
Digging, all night, and the hole kept filling in behind me.
Walking home to the colony, and it got further away with every step.
The sun came up and went straight back down, and we all went back to bed.
[again] The gray dream again. It's getting harder to tell it from the mornings.

warm.li: Even in the gray dream, someone had left a light in the window for me.

blunt.li: Gray dream. Gray morning.

cheerful.li: A gloomy dream, but the sun came up for real afterward, and that helped a bit.

gloomy.li: Dreamt nothing would ever change. Then I woke up, and it hasn't.

cold.li: A gray dream, about the size of the mood I've been in.

plain.li: In my dream they carved my name over the workshop door, and I pretended not to look at it.
My work was still standing a hundred years from now, with children climbing on it.
People came from the next town to see what I'd made, and stood looking at it a long time.
In the dream I showed my old teacher what I can do with {SKILL} now.
[child] I was the best in the whole colony at everything, and they gave me a crown made of bread.
[old] Dreamt the young ones were telling stories about me, and they got most of it right.

warm.li: Every person I've ever worked with lined up to shake my hand. It took all night.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was good at {SKILL}. I am.

cheerful.li: They put up a statue of me in my dream! The nose was wrong, but I loved it.

gloomy.li: I was proud of myself in the dream. Strange feeling. It didn't last.

cold.li: Strangers admired my work all night. Gratifying, and it changes nothing.

plain.li: Dreamt the colony had grown into a town, with lanterns along the paths and children I didn't know.
The first warm morning after a long winter, and everything smelled green.
We were planting trees that wouldn't bear for twenty years, and none of us minded the wait.
The road in front of the colony was full of people coming to stay.
[winter] Dreamt of the thaw: water running under the ice, and the first green on the hill.
[lowtech] Our fields ran all the way to the river, and the granary was too small for the harvest.

warm.li: The people I care about were all in my dream, older and grayer and happier, eating outside under a tree.

blunt.li: Good dream. Things worked out in it.

cheerful.li: Dreamt everything turned out fine! I'm holding the dream to it.

gloomy.li: A hopeful dream. I'll try not to trust it too much.

cold.li: The colony as a town, in the dream. Possible, with work. Perhaps twenty years of it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a hidden door

plain.li: A door in the hill behind the colony, and stairs going down past where the light could follow.
I could read every book ever written, but only one page of each.
I took the sky apart to see how it worked. There were gears behind the clouds.
Followed a strange bird to the edge of the world, and past it there was more world, folded up like a blanket.
[trait:TooSmart] I solved something enormous in my dream and wrote it on my arm. It's just scribbles.
[spacer] I was aboard a ship I've never seen, and every panel I opened had another ship inside it.

warm.li: I found a secret garden and showed it to the others, and they loved it as much as I did.

blunt.li: A door in the dream. Didn't open it. Annoying.

cheerful.li: There was a secret room under the kitchen in my dream! I'm knocking on the walls today.

gloomy.li: Found a door, and it opened onto the same room, over and over.

cold.li: A curious dream. I've written down the parts that might mean something.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the open road

plain.li: The road went on past every horizon, and I walked it without getting tired.
Dreamt I packed everything I own into one bag and walked out the gate, and it closed behind me without a sound.
On a boat, going somewhere, with the wind in the sail.
The colony had wheels, and we were rolling it across the plains toward the mountains.
[tribal] In my dream we followed the herds again, all of us, camp after camp, and never built a wall.

warm.li: We all went on a long trip together in my dream, and sang on the road.

blunt.li: Dreamt I left. Didn't look back.

cheerful.li: I dreamt of a trip to the sea! Somebody should organize that.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the road went on forever. So does this place.

cold.li: A wandering dream. I've been here too long without a change.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an ordinary day

plain.li: Dreamt of an ordinary day: breakfast, work, supper, bed. Nothing went wrong.
In my dream I sat on the step in the evening sun and watched the others come in from the fields.
A cup of tea. That was the whole dream, and it was a good one.
Dreamt we all ate outside on a long summer night and nobody had to be anywhere.
[child] I played all day in my dream, and it never got dark.

warm.li: The whole colony was in my dream, just going about the day, and I loved every one of them.

blunt.li: Good dream. Nothing happened in it.

cheerful.li: Had the nicest dream about absolutely nothing!

gloomy.li: A dream where everything was fine. Hard to believe, even asleep.

cold.li: A dull, pleasant dream. Restful.

plain.li: My teeth came loose one at a time, and I kept putting them in my pocket.
Bit into an apple and it was made of stone.
My mouth was full of pebbles, and I had to give a speech.
[child] I lost all my teeth in my dream and had to eat soup forever.

blunt.li: Teeth dream. Tooth still hurts.

cheerful.li: My teeth fell out and grew back golden!

gloomy.li: Dreamt I lost all my teeth. Not far off.

cold.li: The toothache followed me into my sleep.

plain.li: Lying in an ants' nest, and I couldn't get up.
My blanket was woven out of nettles, and it wouldn't come off.
Something was crawling under my skin, mapping me.
Scratched until I came apart at the seams like an old sack.

warm.li: Someone in my dream spread cool mud on my arms until the itching stopped.

blunt.li: Itched in my sleep. Itching now.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I jumped into a cold river, and the itch floated off downstream!

gloomy.li: Bugs in the dream, bugs in the blanket.

cold.li: The itching shaped my dreams. Expected.

plain.li: I dreamt I was lying awake. Then I woke up, and I was lying awake.
Counted sheep, and the sheep counted me back.
The night went on for three days, and I was the only one who noticed.
I dreamt about sleeping. It looked lovely.

blunt.li: Dreamt I couldn't sleep. Accurate.

cheerful.li: I finally slept, at least in my dream!

gloomy.li: Even my dreams are about not sleeping.

cold.li: Dreamt of insomnia, during insomnia. My mind has run out of material.

plain.li: Carrying a millstone up a hill, and every time I set it down it climbed back onto my back.
I was made of wood, and I creaked whenever I moved.
Wading through deep water, slower with every step.
Trying to get up off the floor all night, and the floor had other ideas.
[old] I was young again in my dream, and nothing hurt. I ran for the joy of it.

warm.li: Dreamt someone carried me home on their back, the whole way.

blunt.li: Hurt in the dream. Hurts now.

gloomy.li: Even in my sleep it hurts.

cold.li: Pain shapes dreams. That's all that was.

plain.li: Breathing through a reed at the bottom of a pond.
The air was thick as porridge, and we all had to chew it.
I was a fish, gulping at the surface.
My head was a bucket full of wool.
[child] My nose was a tap and it wouldn't turn off.

blunt.li: Cold dream. Stuffy. Still stuffy.

cheerful.li: Breathed through my nose all night in the dream! What a luxury.

gloomy.li: Drowning in my own blankets, all night.

cold.li: The cold has reached my dreams. Unremarkable.

plain.li: In my dream I ran all the way to the river and back, and my legs held.
I was a tree in spring, putting out new leaves one at a time.
Carried a full load again and set it down without shaking.
Dreamt of my first good meal after the illness. I could taste it.

warm.li: Everyone who looked after me was in my dream, and this time I was bringing them soup.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was strong again. Getting there.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I was back to my old self! Soon, I hope.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I was well. Not yet.

cold.li: A dream of recovery. Reasonable, at this stage.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the camp's fires

plain.li: In my dream I walked over to the strangers' camp at night, and they made room for me by their fire.
The camp's tents had spread over the whole valley, and our colony was just one tent among them.
The people at the camp were singing a song from my home, and I'd never taught it to them.
Dreamt I woke up in their camp and couldn't find the way back to ours.
[child] I went to live with the camp people in my dream, and they let me ride their animals.

warm.li: The colony and the camp ate together on blankets in the grass, and nobody counted the bowls.

blunt.li: The camp, in my sleep. They're still out there.

cheerful.li: Had a dream the camp threw a festival and invited the whole colony!

gloomy.li: The camp took everything and left in the night. In the dream, anyway.

cold.li: The strangers on our land walked through my sleep. I'll keep an eye on them awake as well.

plain.li: Dreamt the friend I made at the camp came back up the road, waving.
In my dream the camp was still there, and I walked over in the morning like I used to.
Followed the camp's tracks for days in the dream and found them by a river, waiting for me.
Dreamt my friend from the camp and I sent each other messages, and every one arrived.

warm.li: The camp came back up the road, and there was a lot of hugging.

blunt.li: Camp dream. They're gone. That's that.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the camp people moved in for good!

gloomy.li: The road was empty all the way to the horizon.

cold.li: The camp that left. Sentiment, nothing more.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the council table

plain.li: The council table went on for a mile, and every person I've ever known had a seat at it.
We voted on whether the sun should come up tomorrow. It was close.
I gave the speech of my life at the council in my dream, and when I sat down nobody could remember a word of it, me included.
The council met up in the treetops, and we passed the motions up and down in a basket.
[trait:Kind] In the dream everyone at the council table agreed, and then we all went for a walk.

warm.li: Dreamt the council listened to every one of us, right down to the youngest.

blunt.li: Council dream. We argued. Same as awake.

cheerful.li: Got elected to everything in my dream! I'd be terrible at it.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the council decided everything before I got there.

cold.li: I argued the meeting over again in my sleep, and won this time. Irrelevant.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a meeting without end

plain.li: The council meeting lasted a hundred years. The candles burned down and grew back.
Every door into the council meeting led back outside.
In my dream the council voted on me, and I couldn't hear the count.
They decided everything while I slept, and when I woke inside the dream, the colony belonged to someone else.

blunt.li: Council dream. Three hours of it. Tired now.

cheerful.li: A nightmare about a meeting that never ended! At least the bread was good.

gloomy.li: Another meeting in my sleep. I wasn't asked to that one either.

cold.li: A dream about procedure. Tedious, like the real thing.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the sickness on the road

plain.li: Dreamt the sick from the towns were walking up our road in a long line, and the first one knew my name.
In the dream every door in the colony had a mark painted on it except mine.
Carrying water from house to house, in a town I didn't know, and every bed full.
Dreamt I coughed, and the whole colony turned to look.

warm.li: Dreamt our doctor went to the towns and came back with everyone well.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the sickness out there. Washed my hands twice this morning.

cheerful.li: The sickness went right around us, like a storm going around the hill!

gloomy.li: Dreamt the sickness came here. Only a matter of time.

cold.li: We should keep strangers at a distance while the sickness is out there. The dream only confirmed it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an empty granary

plain.li: Opened the granary door, and there was nothing inside but wind.
Dreamt the locusts came down like snow, and when they lifted, the fields were bare to the dirt.
Dividing one loaf among the whole colony, and the slices kept getting thinner.
Dreamt of the hungry towns, and children at our gate holding out bowls.

warm.li: I baked for the hungry towns all night, and the oven never ran out of loaves.

blunt.li: Hunger dream. Counted the stores this morning.

cheerful.li: The famine ended with a rain of bread rolls! I caught six.

gloomy.li: The stores ran out in my dream. One day they will.

cold.li: Our stores are adequate. I dreamt otherwise, so I'll count them again tomorrow.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of lanterns on the road

plain.li: Dreamt the road was lined with lanterns all the way to the fair, and people from everywhere were walking it.
In my dream the pilgrims stopped at our gate and sang until the stars came out.
A market so big you could get lost in it, with a stall for every kind of bread.
Dreamt two old enemies shook hands at our table, then argued about the soup instead.
[child] There was a fair in my dream with a tent full of puppies, and I could take one home.

warm.li: Dreamt the whole region came together for one night, and our colony was part of it.

blunt.li: Good dream about the gathering. We should go.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I won every prize at the fair! Even the pie one.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the gathering. We weren't invited.

cold.li: The gathering in my dream had good prices. Possibly worth attending, for trade.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of riders on the road

plain.li: Riders on the road in my dream, dozens of them, with torches, and they didn't stop at our gate. Not yet.
Dreamt the warband camped on the hill and sat there watching us, night after night.
Had a dream we buried our silver under the floor and then forgot where.
The banners on the road changed every morning, and we never knew whose side we were on.

warm.li: The riders went by, and one of them lifted a hand to me, and I lifted mine.

blunt.li: Fighting on the roads, all night. Sharpened my knife this morning.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the riders went right past and waved!

gloomy.li: They came, in the dream. Sooner or later they will.

cold.li: A dream about the fighting in the region. I'd rather it stayed out there.

plain.li: The ice cracked on the river, and the whole valley turned green in an afternoon.
The seeds came up the moment I put them in, and I couldn't plant fast enough.
Lambs in the fields, so many I had to step over them.
Opened every window in the colony and let the winter out.
[child] Mud! The good squishy kind, all the way up to my knees.

warm.li: First warm day, and we carried the tables outside and ate in the sun.

blunt.li: Spring dream. Fields need work.

cheerful.li: Spring flowers everywhere, even on the roof!

gloomy.li: Dreamt of spring. The mud's real enough.

cold.li: A seasonal dream. Planting is due.

plain.li: In my dream the sun never set, and after a while we stopped working and just sat in the gold light.
Lying in tall grass, and the clouds were spelling words I almost understood.
The heat had turned us all slow and sweet, like honey.
Dreamt we swam in the river at midnight, and the water was warm.

warm.li: Dreamt of a summer evening with everyone outside, and nobody in a hurry to go in.

blunt.li: Hot dream. Hot morning.

cheerful.li: A whole day in the river, in my dream, and I came out wrinkled as a raisin!

gloomy.li: Dreamt the sun would never set. It felt like a threat.

cold.li: A summer dream. The heat gets into everything.

plain.li: The harvest was so big we had to sleep in the fields beside it.
Every leaf on the trees was a different color, and they all came down at once.
We brought in the last of the crops, and sang all the way back.
Dreamt the larder was full to the ceiling, and I could smell every jar.

warm.li: All of us in the kitchen putting up the harvest, steam on the windows, and nobody wanted to leave.

blunt.li: Harvest dream. Then the harvest.

cheerful.li: Dreamt of the biggest pumpkin anyone's ever grown, and it was ours!

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the harvest, and then the long winter after it.

cold.li: A harvest dream, mostly arithmetic. Bushels, jars, days to winter.

plain.li: The snow came up to the roof, and we lived in tunnels under it, warm as mice.
Walking across a frozen lake at night, and I could see fish asleep under the ice.
The cold had a voice, and it was asking to come in.
Dreamt the whole world was white and silent, and the only footprints in it were mine.
[child] I had a sled pulled by a muffalo, and we went so fast the snow couldn't keep up.

warm.li: Dreamt we all slept in one room by the fire, piled up like puppies, while the snow came down.

blunt.li: Snow dream. Snow outside.

cheerful.li: Sledding down the biggest hill in the world, all night!

gloomy.li: Dreamt the winter never ended.

cold.li: Snow, in the dream, silent and very even. I found it restful.
